/* SaleTrnsitnBensonMapper.getSaletrnsitnBensonList */
SELECT A.STORE_CD , A.STORE_NM , A.PROD_CD , A.PROD_NM , A.SPLY_UPRC , A.DATE_BEFORE_0 , A.DATE_BEFORE_1 , A.DATE_BEFORE_2 , A.DATE_BEFORE_3 , A.DATE_BEFORE_4 , A.DATE_BEFORE_5 , A.DATE_BEFORE_6 , A.DATE_BEFORE_7 , A.DATE_BEFORE_8 , A.DATE_BEFORE_9 , A.DATE_BEFORE_10 , A.DATE_BEFORE_11 , A.DATE_BEFORE_12 , A.DATE_BEFORE_13 , A.DATE_BEFORE_0_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_1_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_2_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_3_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_4_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_5_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_6_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_7_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_8_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_9_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_10_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_11_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_12_QTY , A.DATE_BEFORE_13_QTY , A.TWO_WEEK_TOT , A.TWO_WEEK_AVR
, B.IN_WH_CARRY_OUT , B.OUT_WH_CARRY_IN , B.HQ_CURRENT_STK , B.SALE , B.STORE_TOT_STK , TRUNC(B.SALE / DECODE(B.IN_WH_CARRY_OUT, 0, NULL, B.IN_WH_CARRY_OUT),2 ) AS SALE_RATIO , B.FIRST_SALE_DATE , B.LAST_SALE_DATE , B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS , TRUNC(B.SALE / DECODE(B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS, 0, NULL, B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS),2 ) AS DAY_AVR_SALE , TRUNC(B.HQ_CURRENT_STK+B.STORE_TOT_STK / DECODE( B.SALE / DECODE(B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS, 0, NULL, B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS), 0, NULL, B.SALE / DECODE(B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS, 0, NULL, B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS)),2) AS EXHAUSTION_ORG
, B.IN_WH , B.STORE_CURRENT_STK , B.SALE , TRUNC(B.SALE / DECODE(B.IN_WH, 0, NULL, B.IN_WH),2 ) AS SALE_RATIO , B.FIRST_SALE_DATE , B.LAST_SALE_DATE , B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS , TRUNC(B.SALE / DECODE(B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS, 0, NULL, B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS),2 ) AS DAY_AVR_SALE , TRUNC(B.STORE_CURRENT_STK / DECODE( B.SALE / DECODE(B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS, 0, NULL, B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS), 0, NULL, B.SALE / DECODE(B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS, 0, NULL, B.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS)),2) AS EXHAUSTION_ORG
FROM (
SELECT HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, STORE_NM, PROD_CD, PROD_NM, SPLY_UPRC,
TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore0}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_0, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore1}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_1, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore2}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_2, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore3}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_3, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore4}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_4, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore5}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_5, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore6}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_6, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore7}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_7, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore8}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_8, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore9}, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_9, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore10},'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_10, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore11},'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_11, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore12},'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_12, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{dateBefore13},'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS DATE_BEFORE_13,
SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore0}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_0_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore1}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_1_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore2}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_2_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore3}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_3_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore4}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_4_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore5}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_5_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore6}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_6_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore7}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_7_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore8}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_8_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore9}, TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_9_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore10},TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_10_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore11},TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_11_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore12},TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_12_QTY, SUM( DECODE(SALE_DATE, #{dateBefore13},TOT_SALE_QTY, 0) ) AS DATE_BEFORE_13_QTY,
SUM(TOT_SALE_QTY) AS TWO_WEEK_TOT, TRUNC(SUM(TOT_SALE_QTY)/#{diffDay},2) AS TWO_WEEK_AVR FROM (
SELECT A.HQ_OFFICE_CD, B.STORE_CD, C.STORE_NM, A.PROD_CD, A.PROD_NM, A.SPLY_UPRC, B.SALE_DATE, B.TOT_SALE_QTY FROM TB_HQ_PRODUCT A, TB_SL_DAILY_PROD B, TB_MS_STORE C WHERE A.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd}
AND B.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
AND A.HQ_OFFICE_CD = B.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND A.PROD_CD = B.PROD_CD AND B.HQ_OFFICE_CD = C.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND B.STORE_CD = C.STORE_CD
AND A.PROD_CLASS_CD IN ( SELECT PROD_CLASS_CD FROM TB_HQ_PRODUCT_CLASS WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} START WITH PROD_CLASS_CD = #{prodClassCd} AND HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} CONNECT BY PRIOR PROD_CLASS_CD = P_PROD_CLASS_CD AND HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} )
AND ( 'N' = (SELECT NVL(MAX(ENVST_VAL), 'N') FROM TB_HQ_ENVST WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND ENVST_CD = '0001') OR B.STORE_CD IN (SELECT STORE_CD FROM TB_HQ_EMPLOYEE_STORE_V08 WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}) )
SELECT B.HQ_OFFICE_CD, B.STORE_CD, C.STORE_NM, A.PROD_CD, A.PROD_NM, A.SPLY_UPRC, B.SALE_DATE, B.TOT_SALE_QTY FROM TB_MS_PRODUCT A, TB_SL_DAILY_PROD B, TB_MS_STORE C WHERE A.STORE_CD = #{storeCd} AND A.STORE_CD = B.STORE_CD AND A.PROD_CD = B.PROD_CD AND B.HQ_OFFICE_CD = C.HQ_OFFICE_CD AND B.STORE_CD = C.STORE_CD
AND A.PROD_CLASS_CD IN ( SELECT PROD_CLASS_CD FROM TB_MS_PRODUCT_CLASS WHERE STORE_CD = #{storeCd} START WITH PROD_CLASS_CD = #{prodClassCd} AND STORE_CD = #{storeCd} CONNECT BY PRIOR PROD_CLASS_CD = P_PROD_CLASS_CD AND STORE_CD = #{storeCd} )
AND B.SALE_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND A.PROD_CD = #{prodCd}
AND A.PROD_NM LIKE '%' || #{prodNm} || '%'
) GROUP BY HQ_OFFICE_CD, STORE_CD, STORE_NM, PROD_CD, PROD_NM, SPLY_UPRC ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN (
SELECT H.PROD_CD , H.IN_WH_CARRY_OUT , H.OUT_WH_CARRY_IN , H.HQ_CURRENT_STK , H.FIRST_SALE_DATE , H.LAST_SALE_DATE , H.SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS , NVL(M.SALE,0) AS SALE , M.STORE_TOT_STK FROM ( SELECT TSHSC.PROD_CD , NVL(TSHSC.ACC_VENDR_IN_QTY - TSHSC.ACC_VENDR_OUT_QTY,0) AS IN_WH_CARRY_OUT , NVL(TSHSC.ACC_HQ_OUT_QTY - TSHSC.ACC_HQ_IN_QTY,0) AS OUT_WH_CARRY_IN , NVL(TSHSC.CURR_QTY,0) AS HQ_CURRENT_STK , TSHSC.FIRST_SALE_DATE , TSHSC.LAST_SALE_DATE , TO_DATE(TSHSC.LAST_SALE_DATE) - TO_DATE(TSHSC.FIRST_SALE_DATE)+1 AS SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS FROM TB_ST_HQ_STOCK_CUR TSHSC WHERE TSHSC.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND TSHSC.STORAGE_CD = '999' ) H , ( SELECT TSSSC.PROD_CD , SUM(TSSSC.ACC_STORE_SALE_QTY) AS SALE , SUM(TSSSC.CURR_QTY) AS STORE_TOT_STK FROM TB_ST_STORE_STOCK_CUR TSSSC WHERE TSSSC.STORAGE_CD = '999' AND ( 'N' = (SELECT NVL(MAX(ENVST_VAL), 'N') FROM TB_HQ_ENVST WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND ENVST_CD = '0001') OR TSSSC.STORE_CD IN (SELECT STORE_CD FROM TB_HQ_EMPLOYEE_STORE_V08 WHERE HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND EMP_NO = #{empNo}) ) AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM TB_MS_STORE Z WHERE Z.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND Z.STORE_CD = TSSSC.STORE_CD) GROUP BY TSSSC.PROD_CD ) M WHERE H.PROD_CD = M.PROD_CD(+)
SELECT TSSSC.PROD_CD , TSSSC.ACC_STORE_IN_QTY - TSSSC.ACC_STORE_OUT_QTY AS IN_WH , TSSSC.ACC_STORE_SALE_QTY AS SALE , TSSSC.CURR_QTY AS STORE_CURRENT_STK , TSSSC.FIRST_SALE_DATE , TSSSC.LAST_SALE_DATE , TO_DATE(TSSSC.LAST_SALE_DATE) - TO_DATE(TSSSC.FIRST_SALE_DATE)+1 AS SALE_NUMBER_OF_DAYS FROM TB_ST_STORE_STOCK_CUR TSSSC WHERE TSSSC.STORE_CD = #{storeCd} AND TSSSC.STORAGE_CD = '999' AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM TB_MS_STORE Z WHERE Z.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND Z.STORE_CD = TSSSC.STORE_CD)
) B ON A.PROD_CD = B.PROD_CD ORDER BY A.STORE_CD, A.PROD_CD
